title: Simultaneous Approximation by Attracting Basins
summary: We show that any $d\geq3$ pairwise-disjoint open sets $A_1$, ..., $A_d\subset\widehat{\mathbb{C}}$ sharing a common boundary $J$ can be simultaneously approximated by the $d$ attracting basins $\mathcal{A}_1$, ..., $\mathcal{A}_d$ of a rational map $r$ having Fatou set $\mathcal{F}(r)=\mathcal{A}_1\sqcup...\sqcup\mathcal{A}_d$ and so that the Julia set $\mathcal{J}(r)$ approximates $J$.
